items.title: Sidney "Jim Little" Brown Interview, 1960-05-27
items.q: And uh, Sonny Henry took me on that and uh, Fiddler learned, learned music then.

ctx.x: How did you take up the tuba then? How did you take up that big instrument?

Well I was with Sam Morgan at the time. Oh you were playing with him again then? Yeah. Yeah. I was playing with Sam Morgan at the time and they quit using the baseball you see. And I just picked that thing up and I said well I'll be if I can learn it. Three or four weeks I had that and gone. And me and Sam Morgan, brother Albert, Albert Morgan. Yeah. I know him. Yeah. We started learning the horn again. But he was playing with Faith Morgan on the boat. See? Yeah. And uh, Sonny Henry took me on that and uh,…

wrap around here or just an upright tuba? No. Upright tuba. Is it B flat or E flat? E flat tuba. E flat. Well that's, that's an E flat tuba. Oh is that E flat? Yeah that's an E flat up there. I thought most of the big things, Pelican and Suzy Phones were B flat. But that's an E flat. Yeah. That's all you ever played in the E flat tuba. I didn't know.
